### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **generated**. CMake generates the macro interface used to select compiled readers. No runtime environment assignment can add a
backend that was excluded at compile time. This layer has no numerical order.
:::

| definition | producer | reader or role |
|---|---|---|
| `USE_C10D_GLOO` | always defined | no source reader found; not a backend choice |
| `USE_UCX` / `NOT_USE_UCX` | UCX option | process-group implementation and platform default |
| `USE_CUDA` / `NOT_USE_CUDA` | CUDA option | mesh/device dispatch and test availability |
| `NETCDFOUTPUT` / `NO_NETCDFOUTPUT` | NETCDF option | output implementation |
| `PNETCDFOUTPUT` / `NO_PNETCDFOUTPUT` | PNETCDF option | parallel output implementation |
| `NMASS` | cache value | legacy indices; use zero |
| `DISPATCH_MACRO` | nvcc detection | host/device annotation under nvcc, empty otherwise |
| `KINTERA_ROOT_DIR`, `HARP_ROOT_DIR` | configure source directory | no source reader found |
| `_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI` | Torch probe | all compiled translation units |
| `HAVE_AVX512_CPU_DEFINITION`, `HAVE_AVX2_CPU_DEFINITION` | non-Apple compiler setup | Torch headers |
| `COMMUX_WITH_CUDA_RUNTIME` | CUDA with UCX | commux CUDA integration |


### Derivation

No physical derivation applies. Macro substitution happens before compilation, so runtime selection is restricted to
compiled alternatives. The complement macros document an excluded feature rather than implementing a fallback.

### Numerical method

Generation uses `configure_file`; readers then compile the available path. ABI and backend selection must agree across
linked libraries. These definitions have no cell location, ghost stencil or RK-stage dependence.
